strings.59-ФЗ · условия прекращения: Law No. 59-ФЗ · conditions for ending correspondence
strings.59-ФЗ статья 11 часть статьи с условиями: 59-FZ Article 11 part of the article setting the conditions for ending correspondence
strings.Авторское учебное изложение проверенной: Author's training summary of the verified provision, not a website copy
strings.Авторское учебное изложение проверенных: Author's training summary of verified provisions, not a website facsimile
strings.В орган А повторно направлены тот же воп: The same question and attachments were sent again to authority A. Content comparison confirms no new arguments or circumstances. No termination decision exists yet.
strings.В следующем письме гражданин сообщил о н: In the next letter, the citizen reports new damage at the same site and attaches fresh material not previously available.
strings.Все обращения направлялись одному органу: Were all appeals sent to the same authority?
strings.Все условия возможного прекращения подтв: All conditions for possible termination are confirmed
Yes, the recipient details are the same.
strings.Да, я повторяю те же доводы. С текстами: Yes, I repeat the same arguments. I have read the responses.
strings.Для уже опубликованной информации допуст: For information already published, a reply may identify the publication or the official website address where it appears. Verify that the requested information is actually on that official website. A direct link is more convenient, but is not itself the only format permitted by law.
strings.Допускаются два согласованных правомерны: Two coherent lawful routes are allowed; the plan is checked against the chosen route.
strings.Допустимый путь при неприменении права н: A permissible route when the right to end correspondence is not exercised.
strings.Если решение вопросов не относится к ком: If the issues lie outside the recipient's powers, the written appeal is forwarded to the competent body or official and the citizen is notified. An address does not establish authority.
strings.Есть ли новый факт или новое обстоятельс: Is there a new fact or circumstance?
strings.Жалобу на решения и действия работника М: A complaint about a service centre employee's decisions and actions goes to that centre's director. Do not confuse a centre employee with the body providing the service.
strings.Жалобу на решения и действия самого МФЦ: A complaint about the service centre's own decisions and actions goes to its founding authority or an official authorised by a regulatory legal act of the constituent entity.
strings.Жалобу нельзя направить на рассмотрение: A complaint must not be referred for consideration to the body or official whose decision, action or inaction is challenged.
strings.Заблокировать все новые обращения этого: Block all new appeals from this citizen
strings.Закон всегда запрещает рассматривать воз: The law always forbids considering termination, even when every condition is met.
strings.Заменить проверку документов названием и: Replace document verification with the source's name.
strings.Запрет всех последующих обращений выходи: Banning all subsequent appeals exceeds the scope of a decision on a specific issue.
strings.Запрос информации о деятельности власти: A request for information on public-authority activities
strings.Запрос информации рассматривается по спе: An information request follows special rules. If the information does not concern the recipient's activities, apply referral to the competent body with notification to the user.
strings.Зафиксировать фактически принятое решени: Record the actual decision and how it was communicated
strings.Как квалифицировать полномочие уполномоч: How should the authorised official’s power in this case be characterised?
The follow-up clarification has been added to the case file.
strings.Любой сотрудник обязан автоматически пре: Every employee must automatically end all correspondence.
strings.Метка отражает число записей. Сама по се: The label reflects the record count. It does not itself check whether the issue matches, what the responses say or whether new material exists.
strings.Найдите норму и подтвердите её применимо: Find the rule and confirm its applicability to the specific documents in the case.
strings.Найдите положение, которое подходит к ус: Find the provision that fits the established circumstances, not merely the topic of the submission.
strings.Найдите часть статьи с условиями прекращ: Find the part of the article setting the conditions for ending correspondence and enter its number. Link the rule to the established circumstances.
strings.Найдите, является ли прекращение перепис: Determine whether ending correspondence is mandatory when the conditions are met.
Do not announce that the decision has already been made.
Do not rely solely on the counter.
strings.Нет. Я выражаю несогласие с уже изложенн: No. I am expressing disagreement with the responses already given.
strings.Новое письмо поступило, но ещё не зареги: The new letter has arrived but is not yet registered. Calculate the registration deadline. Further correspondence is decided separately.
strings.Новые факты требуют самостоятельной оцен: New facts require their own assessment; the previous case label cannot replace it.
The scenario provides no new circumstances.
strings.Норма предоставляет право при совокупнос: The provision grants a right when all conditions are met, not a duty to terminate automatically.
strings.Один и тот же орган неоднократно дал пис: The same authority has repeatedly given written substantive responses to this exact issue. Comparison confirms no new arguments or circumstances. No decision to end correspondence exists yet. An authorised manager may consider that option, but the law does not require it. The trainee only prepares materials. The calendar task asks for the deadline to register the new letter, not an invented special deadline for a termination notice.
strings.Орган А дважды рассмотрел вопрос о поряд: Authority A twice considered the work arrangements at the site and gave reasoned responses to every argument, with dispatch confirmed. Different departments signed on behalf of the same authority A.
strings.Орган определяет подразделение или должн: The body designates the unit or officials responsible for information access. Publishing a law on a ministry website does not mean that ministry holds every requested local document.
strings.Ответы касались всех нынешних доводов?: Did the responses address all your current arguments?
strings.Отметка информационной системы заменяет: An information-system marker replaces the authorised official’s decision.
strings.Оценить новое обстоятельство отдельно; п: Assess the new circumstance separately; earlier action on the old issue does not block all new materials.
strings.По конкретному вопросу, не запрет всех б: For the specific issue, not a ban on all future appeals.
strings.Подготовить материалы для решения уполно: Prepare materials for the authorised decision-maker
strings.Подготовить материалы уполномоченному ру: Prepare materials for the authorised manager to consider possible termination of correspondence on the specific issue.
strings.Подготовить уведомление на случай принят: Prepare a notice in case a decision to end correspondence is made
strings.Подтверждены условия для возможного реше: The conditions for a possible decision to end correspondence on this issue are confirmed; the decision is optional and is not automatically made by a trainee.
strings.Помощник: «Если прекращение допускается,: Assistant: “If termination is allowed, every other lawful route is a mistake.”
strings.После принятия решения заявителю направл: After the decision, a reasoned reply must be sent to the applicant no later than the following day. This is a separate action, not a new full complaint consideration period.
strings.Потребовать сначала отказаться от права: Require the citizen to waive the right to appeal first.
strings.Правило исчисления в этом учебном деле:: Calculation rule for this training case: exclude the triggering day. Count all calendar days; if the end falls on a non-working day, move it to the next working day. This profile is specified by the scenario and does not automatically apply to every procedure.
strings.Право на прекращение не означает обязанн: A right to terminate is not a duty to exercise it; the chosen route is assessed for consistency.
strings.Прежние ответы по существу совпадающего: Earlier substantive responses to the same issue exist.
strings.Прекращение переписки по вопросу допуска: An authorised person may end correspondence on an issue when all prescribed conditions are met. Check substantive replies, absence of new matters and the same recipient; notify the decision.
strings.При нескольких вопросах, относящихся к р: Where several issues belong to different bodies, copies of the appeal are forwarded to the appropriate recipients. Keep the issues distinguishable.
strings.Применимость к конкретной истории устана: Applicability to a particular story depends on its circumstances. A document title alone does not justify the selected action.
strings.Применить правило независимо от обстояте: Apply the rule regardless of the circumstances.
strings.Принятое действие не обеспечивает необхо: The selected action does not ensure the required verification of the result.
strings.Приёмная органа исполнительной власти Мо: Reception office of a Moscow executive authority
strings.Проверить вопрос, адресата, содержание п: Check the issue, recipient, earlier responses’ substance and absence of new information
strings.Продолжить рассмотрение и подготовить оч: Continue consideration and prepare another substantive response; termination is not mandatory.
strings.Решение о переписке не отменяет учёт пос: A correspondence decision does not cancel recording of receipt.
strings.Самостоятельно заблокировать приём всех: Independently block acceptance of every future letter from the citizen.
strings.Самостоятельно прекратить переписку от и: Independently end correspondence on the manager’s behalf
strings.Сначала установите событие и единицы счё: First identify the starting event and counting units, then find the exact date. The calendar does not choose the applicable law for you.
strings.Сопоставьте выбранный маршрут, полномочи: Compare the selected referral route, powers and plan. Independent actions may be performed in different orders.
strings.Сохранить доступ к подаче других вопросо: Preserve the ability to raise other issues and new circumstances
strings.Сохранён самостоятельный ранее поставлен: This is a retained standalone scenario supplied earlier, not a new variant in this release.
strings.Сравните документы: кто их составил, к к: Compare the documents: who prepared them, and which site and issue they concern. Mark only the materials needed for the selected conclusion.
strings.Считать только прекращение правильным не: Treat termination as the only correct option regardless of authority.
strings.Третье письмо автоматически прекращает в: A third letter automatically ends all the citizen’s correspondence with the authority.
strings.Удалить новое письмо без чтения из-за ст: Delete the new letter unread because of the old history.
strings.Уполномоченное лицо вправе принять такое: The authorised official may make this decision; the citizen must be notified and the scope must remain limited to the specific issue.
strings.Уточните обстоятельства, прежде чем поль: Clarify the circumstances before using the solution to a similar case.
strings.Учебная модель. Принимаете обращение и г: Training model. You receive the appeal and draft referrals to the competent authority and notices. You may not exercise another authority’s powers.
strings.Это право уполномоченного лица, а не авт: A power of the authorised official, not an automatic step
strings.Я снова направил прежний вопрос и те же: I sent the old question and the same attachments again. I have read both responses but still disagree. I have no new information now.
